$comment: Every sampling parameter is written out EXPLICITLY -- including ones that
match the current infer.py defaults -- so a future upstream default change
cannot silently move an approved voice. Nothing here may be omitted at call
time. seed is part of the preset, not a runtime option: hyperframes requires
deterministic rendering, and Irodori's --seed defaults to random.
Voices were designed caption-only (--no-ref), so no reference audio or
speaker embedding is needed and cfg_scale_speaker does not apply.
$engine_note: The Irodori checkout is a SHARED engine, deliberately not copied into this
project: it carries a venv plus a multi-GB HuggingFace model cache, and
duplicating it per video would be waste, not isolation. Its location is
declared here instead of hard-coded in each script, and IRODORI_HOME
overrides it, so moving the engine does not require editing code.

$verification: reference_wav_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the approved take of the fixed
review line. Re-rendering that exact line with this preset must reproduce
the same hash; a mismatch means the environment drifted (checkpoint, codec,
torch version, or device/precision) and the voice is no longer the approved one.
